findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - retry sign-off while an earlier finding remains in an unchanged file.
The new baseline makes unchanged files disappear from the review target, including files containing outstanding findings. Passing those findings in the prompt does not expand Autoreview's allowed target: src/forge/autoreview.py:80–85 documents that findings outside changed files are rejected and a strict sign-off run becomes incomplete. Consequently, reporting an unresolved finding prevents the round from being saved or reaching the owner choice; omitting it permits a clean result without resolving it. Include the earlier open findings in the effective review target alongside changed files. The new test stub returns queued findings without enforcing this scope contract, masking the failure.

Case: normal use - the owner accepts or splits the remaining sign-off findings.
The only assertion proving retention in Known issues reads private state fields and accepts a matching entry in any fix. It never verifies the owning item's public Known issues output. These cases would still pass if the finding were assigned to another fix, including the newly created split fix, instead of the sign-off item. Verify the accepted finding and its owning item through the public command output; the current assertion does not prove the promised behavior.
